_comment: Reviewed exceptions to the licence gate (licenses/policy.json). Empty on purpose.
An entry applies ONLY to a package whose licence is UNKNOWN or missing - it can never waive a forbidden licence.
Every entry needs: ecosystem (npm | python | component), name, version ('*' or exact), reason (what was verified, and where),
reviewedBy, and date (YYYY-MM-DD). An entry without a reason or reviewedBy makes the gate fail with a config error.
An entry that no longer matches any dependency is reported, so this file cannot rot silently.
